title: gsm_rlcmac: Simplify and fix seetting COL_PROTOCOL to 'GSM RLC/MAC'
description:
Currently the dissector sets the COL_PROTOCOL in several paths, always
to the same value. Furthermore, some paths are forgotten (like DL CTRL
blocks), which end up showing "GSMTAP" in COL_PROTOCOL instead.

Fix all those issues by simply setting it once at the start of the
dissector.
